I eat steak all over the world, and this steak from Hanoi, Vietnam was the most expensive ever!
Oct 2025 • Couples
From Japan, I had a card concierge make a reservation.
There were other seats available, but we were ushered into a smaller one.
I want Argentine beef from the beginning. I recommend lamb or pork or wagyu beef, so again,
How do I order Argentine beef because I want to eat it with two people? I asked him.
He was speaking fast and seemed to be recommending a fillet. The waiter's English was still difficult to understand, so I ordered one by one for now, but it was quite a jumble of orders, with only one side menu to choose from and many sauces to choose from.
The first beer I ordered had been forgotten and I had to say it again.
The bread came, I waited a long time and my husband came to the bathroom just in time for the steak, and the fillet and the rib eye were delicious, but the mushroom sauce was the best.
I always go to steak restaurants when I travel abroad, so I thought it would be a lot less than the restaurants I've been at.
But I was really surprised because the amount I checked was about as high as it had ever been in Paris as it was in New York.
The restaurant was casual and honestly the service was terrible.
Considering Hanoi, Vietnam, I regretted going to such a high-end store.

Great lunch in Hanoi

We went to Il Gaucho Steak House for lunch. It was great. I had Iberico pork ribs, which I’d never had, and they were amazing. The fries were perfect. Piping hot, light brown, and soft inside. They also served the meal with crusty hot bread, a whole roasted garlic clove to smear on the bread, as well as herb butter and chimichurri sauce. The service was also spot on. At the end of heh meal we were even given a free shot of frozen caramel vodka that was a nice palate cleanser. I highly recommend this restaurant.

Too expensive and not Argentinean for sure
Jan 2023 • Family
The place is nice, warm and we'll arranged. It has a lot of South American photos and souvenirs,. 
The food slightly resembles Argentinean traditional "parrillas" but for an Argentinean, like me, the plates have only the name, not the size, the thickness, taste and preparation way. I don't know why is it called "Argentinean".
The "provoleta" is highly expensive and not prepared like in my country. My wife asked for sirloin steak which was very thin (compared to a bife de chorizo) . There are no " milanesa" in the menue, and no bife a la pimienta.
I asked of were any Argentinean in the staff, just to talk and there is not.

Beautiful restaurant and very good food
Dec 2022
but...it is very expensive, and to be honest my steak wasn't that great. I tried a USDA rib eye but just found it a bit tasteless. Still, the bearnaise sauce was good, the mashed potato was excellent, and the provoleta starter was awesome. The bread, roasted garlic and dipping sauce was a definite bonus - if I'd known it was coming I wouldn't have ordered the starter. 

Decor is excellent, staff are quick and responsive (mind you there was only one other table of people, probably because I was pretty early). The beer was OK, and the whisky sour was very very good.

But don't forget your wallet because it was about AUD 200 for a single person.
